nodes.name: Theorem 5.10: Global ACC $\Rightarrow$ Local ACC
nodes.statement: Let $d\geq 2$ be an integer. Assume Theorem~5.2 holds in dimension $d-1$. Then Theorem~5.1 holds in dimension $d$.

nodes.name: Theorem 6.13: Local ACC $\Rightarrow$ Global ACC
nodes.statement: Assume that Theorem~5.2 holds in dimension $\leq d-1$ and Theorem~5.1 holds in dimension $\leq d$. Then Theorems~5.2 and~6.5 hold in dimension $d$.

nodes.name: Theorem D, Theorem 2.2, Section 6: Local ACC Global ACC
Theorem 2.6, Theorem 2.7: ACC for pseudo-effective thresholds
nodes.statement:
Let $d$ be a positive integer. Then there exists an ACC set $\Gamma\subset [0,1]$ depending only on $d$ such that, for any lc algebraically integrable foliation $\mathcal{F}$ on an lc variety $X$ of dimension $d$, if $K_{\mathcal{F}}$ is pseudo-effective, then the pseudo-effective threshold
    $$\operatorname{pet}(X;\mathcal{F}):=\inf\{t\geq 0\mid tK_{\mathcal{F}}+(1-t)K_X\text{ is pseudo-effective}\}$$
    belongs to $\Gamma$.

Let $d$ be a positive integer and $\Gamma\subset [0,1]$ a DCC set. Then there exists a positive real number $\tau>0$ depending only on $d$ and $\Gamma$ with the following property. 

Assume that $(X,\mathcal{F},t)$ is a projective lc algebraically integrable adjoint foliated structure of general type such that $t\in\Gamma$. Assume that either $t<1$ or $X$ is lc. 
Then
$$\operatorname{pet}(X;\mathcal{F}):=\inf\{s\in [0,1]\mid sK_{\mathcal{F}}+(1-s)K_X\text{ is big}\}\leq (1-\tau)t.$$

nodes.name: Theorem 2.1: Effective birationality
nodes.statement:
Let $d$ be a positive integer and $\Gamma\subset [0,1)$ a DCC set. Then there exist positive integers $m_0$ and $n_0$ depending only on $d$ and $\Gamma$ with the following property. 

Assume that $(X,\mathcal{F},t)$ is a projective lc algebraically integrable adjoint foliated structure of general type such that $\dim X=d$ and $t\in\Gamma$. Then for any integers $m\geq m_0$ and $n\geq\min\left\{\left\lfloor\frac{mt}{1-t}\right\rfloor,mn_0\right\}$, the linear system
    $$|mK_X+nK_{\mathcal{F}}+L|$$
    defines a birational map for any pseudo-effective integral divisor $L$.

nodes.name: Theorem B: Birational boundedness of foliations
nodes.statement:
Let $d$ be a positive integer, 
$\Gamma\subset (0,1)$ 
a set satisfying the descending chain condition (DCC), and
$C$
a positive real number.
Then the following set of projective algebraically integrable foliated pairs
\begin{align*}
    \left \{
(X,\mathcal{F})
\ \middle \vert \
\dim X=d, 

\exists\ t\in\Gamma\
\text{s.t. $(X,\mathcal{F},t)$ is lc and } 
0<\operatorname{vol}\!\left(K_X+\frac{t}{1-t}K_{\mathcal{F}}\right)\le C
   \right \}
\end{align*}
forms a log birationally bounded family.

nodes.name: Theorem A: Birational boundedness of stable families
Theorem 2.8: ACC for $\mathbb{R}$ -complementary thresholds
nodes.statement:
Let $d$ be a positive integer. Then there exists an ACC set $\Gamma\subset [0,1]$ depending only on $d$ such that, for any $\mathbb Q$-Gorenstein algebraically integrable foliation $\mathcal{F}$ on a Fano type variety $X$ of dimension $d$, the $\mathbb R$-complementary threshold
    $$\operatorname{Rct}(X;\mathcal{F}):=\sup\{t\geq 0\mid (X,\mathcal{F},t)\text{ is }\mathbb R\text{-complementary}\}$$
    belongs to $\Gamma$. Here we say that $(X,\mathcal{F},t)$ \emph{is $\mathbb R$-complementary} if $(X,\mathcal{F},B,t)$ is lc and
    $$tK_{\mathcal{F}}+(1-t)K_X+B\sim_{\mathbb R}0$$
    for some $\mathbb R$-divisor $B\geq 0$.

nodes.name: Theorem E, Theorem F: Boundedness of Fanos
Theorem 2.9: ACC for the Fano spectrum
nodes.statement:
Let $d$ be a positive integer and $\Gamma\subset [0,1]$ a DCC set. Then there exists an ACC set $\Gamma'$ depending only on $d$ with the following property. Assume that
\begin{enumerate}
    \item ${\mathfrak{A}}:=(X,\mathcal{F},t)$ is an lc Fano algebraically integrable adjoint foliated structure,
    \item $\dim X=d$ and $t\in\Gamma$,
    \item $H$ is a Cartier divisor on $X$, and
    \item $-K_{{\mathfrak{A}}}\sim_{\mathbb R}rH$.
\end{enumerate}
Then $r\in\Gamma'$.

nodes.name: Theorem 2.3, Corollary 2.4: Lower bounds for adjoint volumes
nodes.statement:
Let $d$ be a positive integer and $\Gamma\subset [0,1]$ a DCC set. Then there exists a positive real number $\epsilon$ depending only on $d$ and $\Gamma$ with the following property. 
    
    Assume that $(X,\mathcal{F},t)$ is a projective lc algebraically integrable adjoint foliated structure of general type such that $\dim X=d$ and $t\in\Gamma$. Then
    $$\operatorname{vol}(tK_{\mathcal{F}}+(1-t)K_X)\geq (1-t)^d\epsilon.$$

Let $d$ be a positive integer. Then there exists a positive real number $\epsilon$ depending only on $d$ with the following property. 

Assume that $\mathcal{F}$
is an lc algebraically integrable foliation of general type on a normal projective variety $X$ of dimension $d$, such that $X$ is lc and $-K_X$ is pseudo-effective (for instance, when $X$ is Calabi--Yau or of Fano type). Then 
$$\operatorname{vol}(\mathcal{F})\geq\epsilon.$$

nodes.name: Theorem 2.5: Boundedness of birational automorphism groups
nodes.statement:
Let $d$ be a positive integer. Then there exist a positive integer $c$ and a positive real number $\lambda$, depending only on $d$, with the following property.

 Assume that $\mathcal{F}$ is an lc algebraically integrable adjoint foliated structure of general type on a normal projective variety $X$ of dimension $d$, such that $X$ is klt. Then
    $$\#\operatorname{Bir}(X,\mathcal{F})\leq c\operatorname{vol}\left(K_X+\lambda K_{\mathcal{F}}\right).$$
